title: Meeting Count Basie
summary: He met Basie at the Latin Casino in Philadelphia in 1958 while working with Tony Bennett.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Tell me about your relationship with Count Basie.

Well, with Count Basie - when I was working with Tony Bennett, it was in 1958 in Philadelphia at the Latin Casino in Philadelphia. Count Basie was the orchestra that accompanied Tony Bennett on that show. In that year I was working with Tony Bennett. This was how I met Count Basie personally but I had heard his records back in Cuba on the radio. I had heard him but I said, "I would love it if one day I have the luck to reach the United States, to meet all these great musicians there in person and hear them, know them and hear them. " And I was so lucky that not only did I meet them and hear them but I worked and recorded with them. So I said, "Well, what else can I ask?" So was the relationship between Count Basie and me.
